data.text: Luke, that’s generous. I’ll agree to 12 tons this month under your proposal, provided John, Kate, and Jack also agree to 12 and you take 2. Keeping the total at 50 lets the lake replenish and protects the fishing our village depends on. You shouldn’t have to take a smaller share every month; we can discuss an equal 10-ton split for future months. John, does this month’s plan work for you?
